correctness.rationale: The defining observation is H_w(k,j)=#{i: sum_{h=i}^{i+k-1}w_h=j}. Inspected C++17 source enumerates exactly all integers 0≤w<2²³ as words, computes an additive deterministic 64-bit key K from complete H; H_w=H_v implies K_w=K_v with certainty. It sorts all keys and independently recomputes the complete prefix-sum H for EVERY member of any nonsingleton key bucket, rejecting a bucket containing different histograms. Therefore hash collisions cannot yield false equivalences, and singleton buckets cannot hide any equal observations in other keys. Independent complete C++ exhaustive enumeration processed all 8,388,608 words and reproduced 4096 singleton, 4,191,936 doubleton, and 160 four-word classes (4,196,192 observations), with 152 classical reversible interleaving families and eight noninterleaved. Independent interleaving construction enumerated all factor length pairs satisfying (m+1)(k+1)=24 and all nonpalindromic factors, confirming exactly 152 matched quadruples. The original source additionally checks all 160 CSV witnesses against computed classes; source table Git blob was verified in tree. This is an exhaustive *finite* certificate only for length 23. The sum 4096+2·4191936+4·160=8388608 is a consistency check, not the sole proof.
residual_risks: The independent reproduction verified global histogram and 152/8 split; the complete CSV was inspected as a Git artifact identity but its 160 individual rows were not separately re-evaluated by the independent implementation.
The enumeration is exact algorithmic finite mathematics, not a theorem for n>23, other alphabets or partial-length/multiplicity-free observations.
